title: The future of policing one year after George Floyd's death, with Cedric Alexander, PsyD

sentences.en: May 25th is the one-year anniversary of the murder of George Floyd by Minneapolis police officer Derek Chauvin, a shocking crime captured on video that horrified America.
sentences.zh: 5月25日是明尼阿波利斯警官德里克·肖万杀害乔治·弗洛伊德的一周年纪念日，这起令人震惊的罪行被视频记录下来，震惊了全美。

sentences.en: It also sparked months of protests and brought new urgency to long-standing anger over police violence against Black men and women in the United States.
sentences.zh: 它也引发了持续数月的抗议活动，并使人们对美国长期以来针对黑人男女的警察暴力行为所积压的愤怒变得更加紧迫。

sentences.en: In April, Chauvin was convicted of two counts of murder and one count of manslaughter.
sentences.zh: 今年4月，肖万被判两项谋杀罪和一项过失杀人罪成立。

sentences.en: He faces sentencing in June.
sentences.zh: 他将于6月接受判决。

sentences.en: While the verdict brought some sense of justice and relief for many, it did not change the dynamics of racial bias that was a factor in Floyd's death.
sentences.zh: 虽然这一判决为许多人带来了一定的正义感和宽慰，但它并没有改变导致弗洛伊德死亡的种族偏见这一动态因素。

sentences.en: Police reform remains a top priority for many Americans.
sentences.zh: 警察改革仍然是许多美国人的首要任务。

sentences.en: President Biden has urged Congress to pass the George Floyd Justice in Policing Act, which would make it easier for people to sue law enforcement officers in civil court.
sentences.zh: 拜登总统敦促国会通过《乔治·弗洛伊德警务公正法案》，该法案将使人们更容易在民事法庭起诉执法人员。

sentences.en: It would also ban chokeholds, direct police departments to use body and dashboard cameras, and require police officers to learn and use de-escalation techniques.
sentences.zh: 它还将禁止锁喉，指导警察部门使用随身摄像头和行车记录仪，并要求警官学习和使用降级冲突的技巧。

sentences.en: But are these changes enough?
sentences.zh: 但这些改变足够了吗？

sentences.en: If not, what else do we need?
sentences.zh: 如果不够，我们还需要什么？

sentences.en: What would effective police reform look like?
sentences.zh: 有效的警察改革应该是什么样的？

sentences.en: And what can be done to restore the trust between police departments and the communities that they serve, especially people of color communities?
sentences.zh: 为了恢复警察部门与其所服务的社区，特别是少数族裔社区之间的信任，我们能做些什么？

sentences.en: Psychological research has contributed insights into these questions, which we will discuss today.
sentences.zh: 心理学研究为这些问题提供了见解，我们今天将对此进行讨论。

sentences.en: Welcome to Speaking of Psychology, the flagship podcast of the American Psychological Association that examines the links between psychological science and everyday life.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《心理学谈话》，这是美国心理学会的旗舰播客，旨在探讨心理科学与日常生活之间的联系。

sentences.en: I'm Kim Mills.
sentences.zh: 我是金·米尔斯。

sentences.en: Our guest today is Dr. Cedric Alexander, a psychologist with decades of experience in both mental health and law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 我们今天的嘉宾是塞德里克·亚历山大博士，他是一位在心理健康和执法领域拥有数十年经验的心理学家。

sentences.en: He began his career as a police officer and detective in Florida in the 1970s and 80s.
sentences.zh: 他的职业生涯始于20世纪70年代和80年代在佛罗里达州担任警官和侦探。

sentences.en: After more than a decade in law enforcement, he earned a doctorate in clinical psychology and worked as a mental health practitioner and an assistant professor of psychology at the
sentences.zh: 在执法部门工作十多年后，他获得了临床心理学博士学位，并担任心理健康从业者和心理学助理教授。

sentences.en: University of Rochester.
sentences.zh: 罗切斯特大学。

sentences.en: In 2002, he returned to policing as deputy chief of police in Rochester, New York.
sentences.zh: 2002年，他重返警界，担任纽约州罗切斯特市的副警察局长。

sentences.en: He later served as Rochester's police chief deputy commissioner of the New York State Division
sentences.zh: 后来，他担任了罗切斯特市警察局长、纽约州刑事司法服务部副专员、

sentences.en: of Criminal Justice Services, federal security director at the Dallas-Fort Worth International
sentences.zh: 达拉斯-沃斯堡国际机场的联邦安全主管，

sentences.en: Airport, and director of public safety for DeKalb County, Georgia.
sentences.zh: 以及佐治亚州迪卡尔布县的公共安全主管。

sentences.en: He is also a past president of the National Organization of Black Law Enforcement Executives.
sentences.zh: 他还是全国黑人执法高管组织的前任主席。

sentences.en: In 2015, he was a member of President Obama's task force on 21st century policing, which issued a report and recommendations that we'll also talk about today.
sentences.zh: 2015年，他是奥巴马总统21世纪警务工作组的成员，该工作组发布了一份报告和建议，我们今天也会谈到这些内容。

sentences.en: Thank you for joining us today, Dr. Alexander.
sentences.zh: 感谢您今天参加我们的节目，亚历山大博士。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: So let's start by talking about President Obama's task force on 21st century policing.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们先谈谈奥巴马总统的21世纪警务工作组。

sentences.en: It convened in 2015 after the shooting of Michael Brown in Ferguson, Missouri.
sentences.zh: 它是在2015年密苏里州弗格森市迈克尔·布朗被枪杀后召集的。

sentences.en: What were the major recommendations of the task force?
sentences.zh: 工作组的主要建议是什么？

sentences.en: And now, six years later, have any of its recommendations been implemented?
sentences.zh: 现在，六年过去了，它的任何建议得到落实了吗？

sentences.en: Well, there were six pillars to that document that we were directed by President Obama at that
sentences.zh: 嗯，当时奥巴马总统指示我们为那份文件制定六大支柱，

sentences.en: time to come up with as a roadmap to help develop relationships between police and community, which was at another moment of one of those very historic all-time lows.
sentences.zh: 作为帮助发展警察与社区关系的路线图，当时正处于历史性的最低谷时期之一。

sentences.en: So myself and 10 other individuals who were noted in the law enforcement community, civil rights community, and academia, you name it, we were brought together by the White House
sentences.zh: 所以，白宫将我和其他10位在执法界、民权界、学术界等领域享有盛誉的人士召集在一起，

sentences.en: and was given that charge by President Obama at that time.
sentences.zh: 并由奥巴马总统在当时赋予了我们这项任务。

sentences.en: And we had 60 days to come up with some recommendations, which we delivered to him on March 2nd, I believe it was 2015.
sentences.zh: 我们有60天的时间提出一些建议，我相信是在2015年3月2日提交给他的。

sentences.en: But Six Pillars, we established, we had a number of listening sessions across this country, listening
sentences.zh: 关于我们确立的六大支柱，我们在全国各地举行了多次听证会，倾听

sentences.en: to people from all walks of life, from education, human rights, civil rights, unions, you name
sentences.zh: 来自各行各业的人们的声音，包括教育、人权、民权、工会等等，

sentences.en: it, everyone in this nation had an opportunity to come before us either in person or via social
sentences.zh: 这个国家的每个人都有机会通过面对面、社交媒体、

sentences.en: media or they could write in, call in, and leave their thoughts, ideas, and suggestions on how
sentences.zh: 写信或打电话的方式，留下他们关于如何推动国家前进，

sentences.en: to move this country forward and create a relationship or begin to create a relationship between police
sentences.zh: 以及如何开始建立警察与社区之间关系的想法、意见和建议，

sentences.en: and community that would have some influence in terms of changing many of the attitudes of people
sentences.zh: 这将对改变人们和我们社区的许多态度产生影响，

sentences.en: and our community and the long history of abuse which people have experienced and the disconnect between
sentences.zh: 并解决人们长期以来经历的虐待历史，以及警察与社区之间长期存在的脱节问题，

sentences.en: police and community that has been long-standing, particularly communities of color.
sentences.zh: 特别是少数族裔社区。

sentences.en: So the document employed, one particular, was trust and legitimacy, which is pillar one and probably
sentences.zh: 因此，该文件采用的一个重点是信任与合法性，这是第一支柱，也可能是该文件最重要的支柱之一，

sentences.en: one of the most important pillars of that document, because without a police department being seen as being legitimate, you cannot have truSt.
sentences.zh: 因为如果警察部门不被视为合法的，你就无法拥有信任。

sentences.en: And if you cannot have trust, then you cannot have good public safety in any community.
sentences.zh: 如果无法拥有信任，那么在任何社区都无法实现良好的公共安全。

sentences.en: And then there was other pieces in that document as well that talk about Office of Wellness and
sentences.zh: 文件中还有其他部分讨论了警员健康，以及

sentences.en: officers being mentally and physically and psychologically capable of carrying out their functions and
sentences.zh: 警员在心理和生理上是否有能力履行其职能，

sentences.en: making sure as a community we provided them police officers with support that they need to do oftentimes what is a very difficult job.
sentences.zh: 并确保我们作为一个社区，能够为警员提供他们完成这项往往非常艰巨的工作所需的支持。

sentences.en: So a lot of information grew out of that.
sentences.zh: 所以，很多信息都是由此产生的。

sentences.en: One in particular was body cameras.
sentences.zh: 其中特别重要的一点是随身摄像头。

sentences.en: Body cameras became popularized as a result of the 21st Century Task Force report.
sentences.zh: 随身摄像头因21世纪工作组的报告而普及开来。

sentences.en: Body cameras was a way really to help build that trust to really so the public could see as much as they
sentences.zh: 随身摄像头确实是一种建立信任的方式，这样公众就能尽可能多地看到

sentences.en: could as to what occurred based on the statements that were made by officers or witnesses or persons who might have been involved in that event altogether.
sentences.zh: 基于警员、证人或可能参与该事件的人员所作陈述而发生的实际情况。

sentences.en: And body cameras, that technology is very evident today.
sentences.zh: 随身摄像头这项技术在今天非常明显。

sentences.en: Many departments across the country employ body cameras.
sentences.zh: 全国许多部门都采用了随身摄像头。

sentences.en: There's still a few who don't, but many do, particularly in your larger metropolitan communities, but they can be expensive,
sentences.zh: 虽然仍有一些部门没有使用，但大多数部门都在使用，特别是在大型都市社区，但它们可能很昂贵，

sentences.en: not just for the camera itself, but the storage of the information over time.
sentences.zh: 不仅是摄像头本身，还有随时间推移的信息存储成本。

sentences.en: But
sentences.zh: 但是

sentences.en: I think many municipalities and cities and states and counties are just beginning to understand the importance of having this technology available.
sentences.zh: 我认为许多城市、州和县政府才刚刚开始了解拥有这项技术的重要性。

sentences.en: Other things that came out of that, of course, was agencies that evolved in office-involved shootings.
sentences.zh: 当然，由此产生的其他事情还包括涉及警员枪击事件的机构。

sentences.en: It became important that those agencies did not investigate themselves and their own personnel, but there was opportunities for other law enforcement
sentences.zh: 重要的是，这些机构不能调查自己及其人员，而是应该有机会由其他执法机构进行调查，

sentences.en: agencies, preferably an agency that was above that agency in terms of government.
sentences.zh: 最好是政府层级高于该机构的机构。

sentences.en: So if a city police department was involved in a shooting, it was always encouraged that the state law enforcement agency
sentences.zh: 因此，如果某个城市警察局涉及枪击事件，我们总是鼓励由州执法机构

sentences.en: would be an investigative body so that you can maintain a sense of independence and transparency in that
sentences.zh: 作为调查主体，这样你就可以在调查中保持独立性和透明度，

sentences.en: investigation, which allowed the public to feel a sense of fairness in doing those investigations.
sentences.zh: 这让公众在这些调查中感到公平。

sentences.en: And that that agency that was involved in the shooting was being open and transparent, and favoritism was not being given, whether it was real or perceived.
sentences.zh: 并且涉及枪击事件的机构表现得公开透明，没有偏袒，无论是真实的还是感知的。

sentences.en: So there was just numerous recommendations that were made.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们提出了许多建议。

sentences.en: In fact, that document is still up online.
sentences.zh: 事实上，那份文件现在仍然可以在网上找到。

sentences.en: If you just Google 21st Century Task Force final report, it will still pop up and you will see
sentences.zh: 如果你在谷歌上搜索“21世纪工作组最终报告”，它仍然会弹出，你会看到

sentences.en: a great deal of work that went into that document that provided police agencies with a lot of
sentences.zh: 投入到那份文件中的大量工作，它为警察机构提供了许多

sentences.en: ideas and some things they already knew and some things that were new to help guide them along the way.
sentences.zh: 他们已经知道的想法和一些新的东西，以帮助指导他们前进。

sentences.en: And of course, after the Obama administration, when the next administration came in,
sentences.zh: 当然，在奥巴马政府之后，当下一届政府上台时，

sentences.en: they had a very different approach, quite different.
sentences.zh: 他们采取了非常不同的方法，截然不同。

sentences.en: But many police departments across the country still utilize that document, have utilized it since it was published in 2015,
sentences.zh: 但全国许多警察部门仍然在使用该文件，自2015年发布以来一直在使用，

sentences.en: and it certainly can serve as a guide and a roadmap to help us building trust and legitimacy with our communities and with our police agencies across the country.
sentences.zh: 它当然可以作为指导和路线图，帮助我们与社区以及全国各地的警察机构建立信任和合法性。

sentences.en: One of the pillars in that report was to build trust and support by police departments, as you said, by being open and transparent.
sentences.zh: 报告中的支柱之一是通过公开透明来建立警察部门的信任和支持，正如你所说。

sentences.en: What does that mean in real life?
sentences.zh: 这在现实生活中意味着什么？

sentences.en: And are police departments willing to go along with that recommendation?
sentences.zh: 警察部门愿意配合这一建议吗？

sentences.en: Well, if you want to have successful public safety, and since the beginning, and the father of law
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果你想获得成功的公共安全，而且从一开始，执法、公共安全和警务之父，

sentences.en: enforcement, of public safety, of policing, Sir Robert Peel, who was a home secretary in London at the time, created the first police department.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·皮尔爵士，当时是伦敦的内政大臣，创建了第一个警察部门。

sentences.en: And his premise was very simple.
sentences.zh: 他的前提非常简单。

sentences.en: The community is the police and the police is the community.
sentences.zh: 社区就是警察，警察就是社区。

sentences.en: And you fast forward that now, over 150 years later, and what you will find is that no community is safe unless you have community and police working together.
sentences.zh: 现在快进到150多年后的今天，你会发现，除非社区和警察共同努力，否则没有哪个社区是安全的。

sentences.en: If they're separate from each other, if they're in conflict with each other, police are not capable of doing their jobs in order to protect and to serve the community at large.
sentences.zh: 如果他们彼此分离，如果他们处于冲突之中，警察就无法履行职责来保护和为广大社区服务。

sentences.en: And communities will not be safe without trained professionals who are there to take bad people off the road.
sentences.zh: 如果没有受过训练的专业人员将坏人绳之以法，社区就不会安全。

sentences.en: And more importantly, to prevent crime, even before it gets to that place.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，在犯罪发生之前就预防犯罪。

sentences.en: So if you don't have trust between the public and the community,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你在公众和社区之间没有信任，

sentences.en: police departments become delegitimized.
sentences.zh: 警察部门就会失去合法性。

sentences.en: And I can give a police officer all the authority in the world to carry a weapon, to take someone to freedom, to even take their life.
sentences.zh: 我可以给警官全世界所有的权力去携带武器，去剥夺某人的自由，甚至剥夺他们的生命。

sentences.en: This is justifiable.
sentences.zh: 这是正当的。

sentences.en: But what I cannot give you as a police officer is legitimacy.
sentences.zh: 但我作为警官不能给你的是合法性。

sentences.en: That comes from the community.
sentences.zh: 这来自社区。

sentences.en: They have to give you legitimacy.
sentences.zh: 他们必须赋予你合法性。

sentences.en: That means that they have to feel they can trust you.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他们必须感到可以信任你。

sentences.en: They have to feel that they can be heard and listened to.
sentences.zh: 他们必须感到自己的声音被听到和倾听。

sentences.en: They have to feel a sense of connectedness with their local law enforcement agency.
sentences.zh: 他们必须感到与当地执法机构有联系感。

sentences.en: And they have to feel they have a department that is open and transparent.
sentences.zh: 他们必须感到他们拥有一个公开透明的部门。

sentences.en: And they work together as a team.
sentences.zh: 他们像团队一样共同工作。

sentences.en: Police departments can no longer work as this clandestine operation that is apart from the community.
sentences.zh: 警察部门不能再像这种脱离社区的秘密行动一样运作了。

sentences.en: You have to be very much a part of community.
sentences.zh: 你必须真正成为社区的一部分。

sentences.en: And this is what community is demanding.
sentences.zh: 这就是社区所要求的。

sentences.en: And to be perfectly honest with you, this is what we should have been doing from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 老实说，这正是我们从一开始就应该做的。

sentences.en: But we lost our way in this.
sentences.zh: 但我们在这方面迷失了方向。

sentences.en: But we're in a very, very different time in the history of this nation that is very diverse, not in terms of just the obvious of race and gender,
sentences.zh: 但我们正处于这个国家历史上一个非常、非常不同的时期，这个国家非常多元化，不仅仅是在种族和性别这些显而易见的事情上，

sentences.en: but diverse in the terms of how we think and see and feel and cognitively, I should say, experience this world.
sentences.zh: 而且在我们的思维、观察、感受方式上也是多元化的，我应该说，在认知上体验这个世界的方式上也是如此。

sentences.en: And everyone sees it very, very differently.
sentences.zh: 每个人看待它的方式都非常、非常不同。

sentences.en: And for anyone that's a city leader or police leader in that community, you really have to be an individual who understands the dynamics of
sentences.zh: 对于任何社区的城市领导者或警察领导者来说，你必须是一个了解多元化动态

sentences.en: diversity and be respectful of it at all levels.
sentences.zh: 并在各个层面尊重它的人。

sentences.en: If you're going to be a strong leader, a good leader, a credible leader, a legitimate leader to the people in which you serve.
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名强大的领导者、优秀的领导者、可信的领导者、对你所服务的人民合法的领导者。

sentences.en: So you've just given pretty much the definition of community policing.
sentences.zh: 所以你刚才几乎给出了社区警务的定义。

sentences.en: And I know you're a strong advocate of that as a practice.
sentences.zh: 我知道你作为一种实践，是它的坚定倡导者。

sentences.en: Are there some communities you could name that have been successful in this respect?
sentences.zh: 你能列举一些在这方面取得成功的社区吗？

sentences.en: Can you give us some examples of who's doing it right at this point?
sentences.zh: 你能给我们举一些目前做得好的例子吗？

sentences.en: Well, it's not a matter so much of naming any particular community.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这与其说是命名任何特定的社区的问题。

sentences.en: I think all communities struggle with it.
sentences.zh: 我认为所有社区都在为此挣扎。

sentences.en: You know, if you're a Mayberry RFD and you got a, you know, you got an Andy Griffin and you got a Barney Fife and everybody knows everybody in that small little half a square mile,
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你在《梅伯里小镇》里，你有安迪·格里菲斯和巴尼·法伊夫，每个人都认识那个半平方英里、

sentences.en: a quarter of a square mile community, that's a beautiful thing, right?
sentences.zh: 四分之一平方英里社区里的每个人，那是一件美好的事情，对吧？

sentences.en: That would be great.
sentences.zh: 那会很棒。

sentences.en: But unfortunately, oftentimes it does not work that way in many of our communities across this country.
sentences.zh: 但不幸的是，在全国许多社区中，情况往往并非如此。

sentences.en: And that does say that that does not exiSt. But in most cases, and certainly the communities that we
sentences.zh: 这并不是说它不存在。但在大多数情况下，当然是我们

sentences.en: come across and those that are oftentimes troubled or run into these predicaments that create a great
